kl_matches_native.method: exact source of MDU _null_anchor_kl executed in a shim vs our port, float64, identical inputs

kl_direction_student_to_anchor.precision_note: native _null_anchor_kl casts logits with .float(); KL is computed in FP32, so verification tolerance is FP32-scale (observed residual ~2.6e-07).
kl_direction_student_to_anchor.note: forward KL pulls the STUDENT conditional toward the FROZEN prompt-masked anchor

tau_multiplies_anchor_logits.note: tau*logits is equivalent to temperature 1/tau; tau<1 FLATTENS the anchor. Implemented as multiplication, matching native.

teacher_detached.method: anchor logits given requires_grad=True; after backward its .grad must be None/zero

anchor_is_prompt_masked.note: anchor = frozen model on [MASK x prompt | same partially-masked answer]
